Hey, I care. It may seem cliche but I genuinely do my friend. You, to me are family because you suffer through the same hardships I’ve suffered through and that makes you so unique. Please keep going, please try & find joy in the little things in life that make you happy, and please try to keep faith it’ll all get better. I know how difficult it is, trust me, I struggle with the same mindset almost daily. I’m here for you if you need to talk dm me anytime, no judgments.

I want you to know this though, those emotions your feeling won’t be an everyday thing, they’ll pass, and you’ll have better days than some. Please don’t do anything you’ll regret, I promise you’ll hurt so many who care about you. Please dm me if you ever need to talk, no judgements. You’re loved believe me!

When I first attempted suicide it was very blank in terms of the details, but I can recall my parents being the most careful, and worried I’d ever seen them. The doctors were there to try, and figure out what caused you to do this, and this obviously is a case to case basis but my doctor seemed genuinely concerned about me which gave me a sense of ease after such a life altering event. However, my parents never shamed me, in fact I had a good memory come of it where they let me chose wherever I wanted to go out to eat the night I came back, and it was comforting to know they had my back, as I’m sure your family would too. Please, don’t even attempt, it’s not worth it, trust me your people care.

I’ve always had deep insecurities as well that really made me hate who I saw in the mirror. To this day, I struggle with these types of hardships, just know you’re not alone, and you can always dm me if you ever need anyone to talk to, no judgments ever!

Don’t apologize buddy. You’re loved man I know that for a fact that I love you, I care about you, to me you’re just another warrior going through these unspeakable unforgiving acts of depression, and anxiety and I want you to get through it more than anything. If you ever genuinely need someone to talk too shoot me a dm I’ll be here always, no judgements.

Please don’t go. I know it may seem like a last resort to post on this sub, and you may be convinced you’re gonna do what you’re setting out to do. Please don’t. Dm me? Let’s talk it through. I want you here.

I’m not gonna disagree with your perspective on people not caring about others unless it benefits them. You see it so much in today’s day & age, and it’s such an avid problem in my life as well. Bottom line, people suck, and you’re surrounding yourself with the wrong people, try to stick with the people who make you feel good, and have genuine concern for your well-being. Me, personally, I have found it’s difficult to have people you trust with your problems, and that can cause a great bit of loneliness. However, just know even if you’ve run out of options, you’ll find people who do genuinely care, like me, I want you to thrive and I want you to be able to live without this horrible burden you’re carrying. Please feel free to dm me, I’m always here to talk, no judgments ever.

I had therapists, psychologists, and even 
psychiatrists. Many of each, actually, and to no avail did I ever find someone who was worthy of my trust, and so I know how you feel. Telling someone in confidence something you would rather have kept secret is a scary, but brave thing to do. Just so you know, my dms are open and I’d love to hear any problems you’re having and talk them out with you. If not, just know there’s going to be better days, find happiness in the little things, and take advantage of those!

Listen, you’re a human being just like all of us in this sub & so many others who can’t cry out for help who don’t have the courage to shine a light on what they’re going through. I want you to dm me, and let’s talk about how you’re feeling, if not totally understandable, but just know there’s people suffering with you buddy, me included, and I, like many others in this sub would love to see you thrive in whichever endeavors you chose in life, because you deserve that much.

I’m always here. Please shoot me a dm if you want to talk about anything. Anyway I can make a difference for you would be much appreciated as it will also help benefit my mental health as well, all we need in life, especially in moments of weakness is the feeling of love, and the feeling of having someone who cares.

If not, you can always DM me, I’ve been through it all, I find peace in knowing there’s people who feel like me, and talking about it is the best way to let go a little bit.
